params.caption: 🖥️ Seagate brings back hybrid storage with the FireCuda Forge Seagate's FireCuda Forge is an 8TB or 20TB external hard drive with a slot for your own M.2 2280 NVMe SSD (ideally 1TB with DRAM). Tom's Hardware's hands-on says it works smoothly once the SSD is in, but it is still pricey if you don't already own a spare SSD. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 14:01 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware #Seagate #PCHardware #GamingNews
